fields.statement: QA at 66e50695 with a built binary in a scratch repo: change new 'Link it' --ref with ESC, newline and backticks; --json and change show --json returned it verbatim (\u001b, \n); human change show printed '- Ref: "https://ex.com/i/1\x1b[31m\n`x`"' with no raw ESC (cat -v); the open entry is stored at v 4 with a ref key, and a change set without --ref has none. A binary built from the merge-base refused the entry: 'newer format: field "v": 4, this Rhiza reads 3'. go test ./internal/changeset/... and TestScripts/change-set-ref pass.

QA at 66e50695 with a built binary: a scratch root plus project, daemon --once --max-runs 0 --event-command appending stdin to a file; after the recording first poll, proposed and accepted moves of a change set with --ref https://github.com/o/r/issues/42 and a proposed move of one without. The second poll wrote three payloads: both moves of the first carry "ref":"https://github.com/o/r/issues/42" verbatim, the plain one has no ref key. TestDaemonEventsRef passes.

QA at 66e50695 with a built binary: run start --workflow plan --new 'Planned' --ref 'https://ex.com/9' --permission-mode manual queued the plan run and opened a change set whose change show --json has "ref":"https://ex.com/9"; run start --workflow plan --ref x without --new is a usage error '--ref goes with --new'. The daemon's detached start (needs Rex and an agent) was not run by hand; TestRequestPlanRunArgsPassRef covers that the plan run arguments carry --ref for a request with one and none without.

QA at 66e50695 with a built binary: request 'Fix login' --kind bug --ref '  https://github.com/o/r/issues/7  ' stored it trimmed; a ref with an OSC sequence, BEL and newline came back verbatim in request ls --json and Go-quoted in human request ls ('[ref "x\x1b]0;pwn\a\ny"]', no raw control bytes); 2048 bytes queued; 2049 bytes exited 2 with '--ref is 2049 bytes, at most 2048' and queued nothing; --ref '' queued a request with no ref key. TestScripts/request-ref and describe-golden pass.

QA at 66e50695: read prBodyRef and its use in ship open-pr (the ref from the change set's open, appended to the summary as one inline code span with backticks, CR/LF and control characters escaped). Opening a real PR needs gh and was not run by hand; go test ./internal/api -run OpenPR passes, including TestShipOpenPRBodyRef (backticks, newline and @mention ref in one escaped span; no ref line without a ref).
